existing_issue_conflict.observed: A fresh read after the offline restart put the original issue edit in Needs attention. The submitted and GitHub fields remained readable, and the trace contained no write.

native_creation_inventory.observed: Owned Windows controls and Ctrl+N exposed no issue-creation action. The only write in this run was a confirmed ordinary comment.

source_audit.observed: Native commands and durable intent types cover existing issues, ordinary comments, reviews, replies, thread resolution, and direct merges. The typed writers use the original issue, comment, review, thread, or PR identity. The complete set includes no issue or PR creation operation or fallback.
